title: Ball de bastons
summary: A Catalan stick dance in which dancers in rows strike each other's sticks in patterns of rhythms.
howToPlay: Four pairs of hands hold their sticks one above the other, in a column. Strike the pair a closing ring marks, on the beat, and its sticks cross and clack together.
The pairs are the first, second, third and fourth from the top (from the left on a wide screen).
Keep a steady count: the clash runs up and down the column.
rules: A stroke on the beat is perfect, a near one is good, and an extra stroke costs points.
The round ends when the last stroke has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: In ball de bastons the dancers stand in two rows and strike their sticks together in set rhythmic patterns, to a tune and a drum.
credits: Tradition: ball de bastons of Catalonia; patterns written for this game
